name: Grilled pork paste
summary: Minced pork grilled until the edges char, sometimes around a lemongrass stalk. You roll it in rice paper with herbs, tart green banana, cucumber, and sour mango.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 lists nem nướng among the plates to eat in Buon Ma Thuot.
howToEat: Add crisp fried sausage and fresh rice noodles to the roll, then dip it in a thick, warm sauce that is salty-sweet and nutty from peanuts.
where: Thanh Trầm, Thanh Loan, and Thanh Thủy.
seoTitle: Nem nuong in Buon Ma Thuot — grilled pork paste
seoDescription: Grilled minced pork rolled in rice paper with herbs, green banana, and sour mango, dipped in a warm peanut sauce.
